paths.title: AI for Accountants & Bookkeepers
paths.tagline: From safely summarizing dense documents to building your own client-communication system.
paths.description: A ladder of 10 hands-on lessons for accountants and bookkeepers covering the AI workflows that save real time without risking confidentiality or accuracy: summarizing long financial and policy documents safely, turning rough notes into client-ready explanations, drafting reminders and information requests, explaining financial concepts in plain language, documenting internal processes, writing variance narratives, running better client meetings, building reusable communication templates, structuring data-cleaning work before spreadsheets, and creating staff training material.
